note: CareFlow's own audit templates for home care, written from public regulations and guidance. They are not copied from any commercial audit product. Review them against your own policies before use.

sources.source: CQC: Regulation 12, Safe care and treatment
DHSC: The Health and Social Care Act 2008 code of practice on the prevention and control of infections
UKHSA / DHSC: Infection prevention and control in adult social care settings
NICE CG139: Healthcare-associated infections: prevention and control in primary and community care
HSE: Control of Substances Hazardous to Health (COSHH)

areas.name: Care quality
areas.description: How good the care is: care plans and records, person-centred care, dignity, consent and outcomes.

areas.name: Daily checks
areas.description: Short, frequent checks: rotas and visit cover, late and missed calls, medicines and equipment.

areas.name: Dementia
areas.description: Support for people living with dementia: assessment, communication, distress and families.

areas.name: Infection prevention
areas.description: Hand hygiene, protective equipment, waste, outbreaks and staff health.

areas.name: Leadership
areas.description: Governance, oversight by the registered manager, staff support, learning and improvement.

areas.name: Operational
areas.description: Running the service: recruitment files, training, complaints, records and information governance.

areas.name: Safety alerts
areas.description: National patient safety and medical device alerts: received, checked and acted on.

areas.name: Risk and safety
areas.description: Risk assessments, safeguarding, falls, moving and handling, fire and lone working.
